request_routes.label: Adalimumab and biosimilars for covered indications
request_routes.routing_notes: Initial approval criteria are listed in Section II and continuation criteria in Section III.
request_routes.evidence: Aetna considers adalimumab, or its biosimilar, medically necessary for the following indications when criteria are met.

route_guards.label: Documented negative TB testing before therapy initiation
route_guards.evidence: For all indications: Member has had a documented negative tuberculosis (TB) test (which can include a TST or an IGRA) within 12 months of initiating therapy for persons who are naïve to biologic drugs or targeted synthetic drugs associated with an increased risk of TB. If the screening is positive, there must be further testing to confirm there is no active disease. Do not administer the requested medication to members with active TB infection. If there is latent disease, TB treatment must be started before initiation of the requested medication.

route_guards.label: No concomitant biologic or targeted synthetic therapy for the same indication
route_guards.evidence: For all indications: Member cannot use the requested medication concomitantly with any other biologic drug or targeted synthetic drug for the same indication.

condition_clusters.evidence: For adult members for treatment of moderately to severely active RA when the member meets biomarker documentation and conventional therapy failure criteria, or for adults who have previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic drug within the past 120 days.

For adult members who are using the requested medication for moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis and who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response as evidenced by disease activity improvement of at least 20% from baseline in tender joint count, swollen joint count, pain, or disability.

Members 2 years of age or older with moderately to severely active articular JIA who have previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic drug or meet failure criteria for methotrexate/conventional synthetic therapy, or inadequate response to NSAIDs/intra-articular glucocorticoids plus risk factors.

For members 2 years of age or older using adalimumab for moderately to severely active articular JIA who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response as evidenced by improvement in active joints, limitation of movement, or functional ability.

Adult members with active psoriatic arthritis who have previously received a biologic/targeted synthetic or who have mild to moderate disease with inadequate response/intolerance to methotrexate, leflunomide, or comparably severe features or axial/enthesitis disease.

For adult members using adalimumab for psoriatic arthritis who achieve or maintain low disease activity or improvement in swollen/tender joints, dactylitis, enthesitis, axial disease, skin/nail involvement, functional status, or CRP from baseline.

Adult members with active ankylosing spondylitis or active non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis who have previously received a biologic/targeted synthetic drug or who have inadequate response or intolerance to two or more NSAIDs.

section_path: D. Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA)

condition_clusters.evidence: For adult members using adalimumab for ankylosing spondylitis or nr-axSpA who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with low disease activity or improvements in functional status, spinal pain, inflammation, swollen/tender joints, or CRP from baseline.

section_path: D. Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA)

condition_clusters.evidence: For treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for moderately to severely active CD who achieve or maintain remission or a positive clinical response evidenced by improvement in abdominal pain, diarrhea, weight, abdominal mass, hematocrit, mucosal appearance, or disease activity tools.
For treatment of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for moderately to severely active UC who achieve or maintain remission or a positive clinical response evidenced by improvement in stool frequency, rectal bleeding, urgency, CRP, fecal calprotectin, mucosal appearance, or disease activity scoring tools.

Adult members with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who have previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic or who meet criteria for involvement of crucial body areas, significant BSA, or 3% BSA with inadequate response/intolerance or avoidance of phototherapy or methotrexate/cyclosporine/acitretin.

Continuation is medically necessary for adults using adalimumab for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response demonstrated by reduction in body surface area affected or improvement in itching, redness, flaking, scaling, burning, cracking, or pain.

Members age 12 or older with moderate to severe HS who previously received a biologic indicated for HS or had an inadequate response to oral antibiotics for at least 90 days or intolerance/contraindication to antibiotics.

Continuation is medically necessary for members 12 years and older using adalimumab for moderate to severe HS who achieve or maintain low disease activity or improvement in abscess/nodule count, sinus tract formation, lesion frequency, pain, suppuration, relapse frequency, quality of life, or disease severity scores.

Members 2 years and older with non-infectious intermediate, posterior, and panuveitis who previously received a biologic or who had inadequate response/intolerance to corticosteroids or immunosuppressive therapy.

section_path: I. Uveitis (non-infectious intermediate, posterior and panuveitis)

condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for members 2 years and older using adalimumab for non-infectious uveitis who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response evidenced by reduced flare frequency, stability/improvement in AC cell grade, vitreous haze, visual acuity, reduced glucocorticoid needs, or no new active inflammatory retinal lesions from baseline.

condition_clusters.evidence: Members who previously received apremilast or a biologic indicated for Behçet’s disease, or who had an inadequate response to at least one non-biologic medication such as azathioprine, colchicine, cyclosporine, or systemic corticosteroids.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using the requested medication for Behçet’s disease who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response as evidenced by low disease activity or improvement in signs and symptoms.

Members who previously received a biologic indicated for pyoderma gangrenosum or who had an inadequate response to corticosteroids or immunosuppressive therapy (e.g., cyclosporine or mycophenolate mofetil) or intolerance/contraindication to those therapies.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for pyoderma gangrenosum who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response as evidenced by low disease activity or improvement in signs and symptoms.

Members with moderate or severe immunotherapy-related inflammatory arthritis who have had an inadequate response to corticosteroids or a conventional synthetic drug or intolerance/contraindication to both.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Does the member have a documented negative tuberculosis test (TST or IGRA) within 12 months if naïve to biologic/targeted synthetic therapy, with confirmation of no active TB if the screening was positive?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Ensure TB screening is complete before initiating therapy.
criteria_catalog.policy_time_language: within 12 months prior to initiating therapy or after confirming no active disease
criteria_catalog.evidence: Member has had a documented negative TB test within 12 months of initiating therapy for persons naïve to biologic or targeted synthetic drugs associated with increased risk of TB. If screening is positive, there must be further testing to confirm no active disease and treatment of latent disease prior to initiation.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Is the requested adalimumab not being used concomitantly with any other biologic or targeted synthetic drug for the same indication?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Prevent concomitant biologic/targeted synthetic use for the same indication.
criteria_catalog.evidence: Member cannot use the requested medication concomitantly with any other biologic drug or targeted synthetic drug for the same indication.

notes.parsing_notes: Derived from Aetna CPB 0655 covering adalimumab and its biosimilars; appendices not available.
